scope: 720-item base game; excludes Myths and Monsters

methodology.recipe_semantics: Each recipe requires BOTH ingredients. Different recipes for an item are alternatives. Ingredient order is irrelevant.
methodology.recipe_entry_vs_combination: A recipe entry has one result. A distinct input pair can have multiple results.
methodology.selected_routes: One acyclic suggested recipe per craftable item, preferring routes that do not require Time. Not a globally shortest-action proof.
methodology.depth_without_time: Minimum nesting depth using recipes from the four starters, ignoring progress unlocks. It is not a click count.
methodology.build_sequence: One structurally validated full-discovery sequence. Counts all outputs of a pair and unlocks Time after 100 discoveries. Does not depend on other optional automatic unlocks.
methodology.extra_unlocks: Non-Time unlock conditions are preserved from source metadata; current Android behavior was not independently verified.
